Class Tribe

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.model.Tribe
public class Tribe extends Object
Represents a player's tribe, containing their acquired character and building cards. Provides methods to calculate total discounts and icons based on the cards in the tribe.

      the total sustenance discount
